portspoof-start.title: portspoof-start
portspoof-start.description: Enhance OS security through a set of techniques This package contains a service to enhance OS security through a set of following techniques: * All 65535 TCP ports are always open Instead of informing an attacker that a particular port is in a CLOSED or FILTERED state Portspoof will return SYN+ACK for every port connection attempt/ * Every open TCP port emulates a service Portspoof has a huge database of dynamic service signatures, that will be used to generate fake banners and fool scanners. This tool requires configuration before use.
